description: Opt-in: let Renovate auto-merge Terraform/Terragrunt minor, patch, digest, pin and lock file updates when the plan is a no-op. Safe ONLY in a repository whose CI posts a terraform/plan-noop commit status on every pull request that changes Terraform (success for a plan with no changes, pending otherwise). With platformAutomerge false, Renovate merges only once every status is green, so a pending plan holds the PR for a person. A repository without that status has nothing holding a plan that changes infrastructure. Extend it after the base preset and before any local protected denylist, so the denylist still wins: extends: ["github>LukeEvansTech/renovate-config", "github>LukeEvansTech/renovate-config:terraform-plan-gated"].

packageRules.description: Plan-gated Terraform automerge. Overrides the base preset's automerge:false for these managers (last-match-wins). Majors stay manual: they never match here.
